purpose: Run a lab-only persistent multigeneration SLIP lineage runner over current profiles without claiming package runtime integration, manual readability calibration, or profile-weighted evolution.

external_anchors.source: Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites
external_anchors.used_for: Archive updates are tracked as niche-preserving quality-diversity decisions instead of scalar winner-only selection.
Lineage records and generation-by-generation outcomes are treated as experimental artifacts, not implicit runtime state.
